event: A person is deciding to finish cooking, and the location of another person involved in the conversation is determined relative to an imagined robot's facing direction.

sounding_object.description: Adult male (Person B), with dark curly hair, wearing a grey short-sleeved t-shirt, dark shorts (possibly blue or black), and dark sneakers. This is the person whose location is being determined relative to the robot during the speech event.

reference_object.description: Black, flat, glass-ceramic electric cooktop, built into a granite countertop. It has red glowing indicators when burners are active. The robot is standing by this object.

facing_object.description: Stainless steel double-basin sink with a gooseneck tap, set into a granite countertop. The robot is facing this object.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the electric cooktop and facing the double-basin rectangular sink and tap, when the speech topic: "deciding to finish cooking" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
